newsitem.title: INDIA: Colleague's spectacles save Indian minister.
newsitem.headline: Colleague's spectacles save Indian minister.

text.p: Indian Home (Interior) Minister Indrajit Gupta held up his own swearing-in ceremony on Monday but was finally saved by a colleague's spectacles.

When Gupta's name was called to read the oath as a minister in Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's new centre-left government, the 78-year-old communist frantically rummaged through his pockets for his glasses.

As President Shankar Dayal Sharma and dignitaries waited in silence at the ceremony in the presidential palace, Gupta gave up his search and asked Agriculture Minister Chaturanan Mishra to lend him his spectacles.
Mishra, who had just taken the oath of office, quickly handed them over, and spectators burst into laughter as Gupta fixed the glasses on his nose to read the oath before a beaming president.
